title: situation.s13_treasury_notes.title

gate.none: Proposed for review: this paper concerns military command, administration or finance; it contains no policy toward a protected population, security order or atrocity consequence.

citations.at: pp. 7, 9; Chase’s December 1862 retrospective explanation of the December 1861 suspension and subsequent note issues. It is not a contemporary December 1861 message.

namedOnly: Names of addressees, the subjects of allegations or custody, and prospective appointees identify the dated document’s participants; they do not assert that those people hold a post now.
